overview: Famous Temples of Bharat is a comprehensive web application for discovering and exploring temples across India. Users can search for temples by name, deity, state, city, or tradition, and access detailed information including history, darshan timings, poojas, donations, festival calendars, and visitor reviews. Features include browse-by-state grid, temple of the day spotlight, Stripe donation payments, map routing to temples, user and admin dashboards, bookmarking, and FAQs.
features: 165 temples across all 28 Indian states and 8 union territories
Browse-by-state grid on homepage for quick discovery
Temple of the Day daily spotlight feature
Stripe donation payments on temple detail pages
Fuzzy search by name, deity, state, city, or tradition
Detailed temple pages with history, timings, poojas, festivals, nearby amenities, and map routing
User and admin dashboards with bookmarking and visit history
Reviews and FAQs for every temple
